prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective moving steadily along a dimly lit road in East Maddon Park, London, under a heavy rain shower at night. The camera advances forward, capturing the wet pavement reflecting the soft glow of street lamps that line both sides of the road. As the viewer progresses, the camera pans slightly to the right, revealing more of the park's surroundings, including trees shrouded in mist and faintly illuminated by the scattered lamplight. The camera continues its forward motion, passing by a crosswalk marked with white stripes, and then turns left at an intersection, following the curve of the road. The ambient light from the street lamps casts a pale yellow hue, contrasting with the dark, rainy sky. The camera maintains a steady pace, occasionally adjusting its angle to navigate the bends in the road, providing a continuous view of the empty urban park enveloped in the serene yet somber atmosphere of a rainy night. The scene remains consistently quiet and devoid of people, emphasizing the solitude and stillness of the environment.
location: East Maddon Park, London, United Kingdom
